title: I created an AI-powered PBR generator with many free features, such as normal map generation and PBR material generation!
author: staszek0001
selftext:
Hi! For almost a year, we’ve been working on a tool designed to generate PBR textures from images and text prompts.

Recently, PBRIZE received its 2.0 update, introducing many new features and improvements that make texture generation even more powerful and flexible.

Many of the tools available in PBRIZE are completely free and run locally using your own GPU, so if you’d like to give it a try, visit [PBRIZE.com](http://PBRIZE.com) or check out our latest video, which I’ve linked below!

I’m not really looking to promote it here I’m mainly interested in hearing your thoughts about the tool itself. I’m sure many people here have tested different texture generators, both free and paid, so I’d really appreciate a broader perspective and any honest feedback you’re willing to share.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: if I run everything locally, is it always free?

replies.author: staszek0001
replies.body: Hey, yes, local generators are free, for example normal map, free pbr generation, chroma Key and all tools that don’t need tokens to create!
